## Why

The reviewer reported this as tool feedback (friction) on ork in ork run ork-20261117-233556-f24d, project ork, item S388:
Say in the reviewer prompt that the harness may start the reviewer in plan mode and that the report then goes in the final message
Evidence: this session started in plan mode with an ExitPlanMode instruction that conflicts with the reviewer contract's final-report rule

Merged on 2026-11-18 (duplicate sweep): S412 (no reviewer under Grok plan mode, run ork-20261117-215053-c643, S402), S414 (no gate under Grok plan mode, same run) and S427 (brief says whether gate mode applies, run ork-20261118-121813-4c84, S404: "session started in plan mode demanding ExitPlanMode, which is not in the reviewer's tool list"). This slice covers the reviewer and the gate, on Claude and on Grok.

Evidence (2026-11-18):

- ork starts every cloud read-only role in plan mode on purpose: Claude with `--permission-mode plan` unless it is a UI pass with a write directory (`internal/agent/claude/args.go:103-105`), Grok with `--permission-mode plan` (`internal/agent/grok/grok.go:3-5`, `internal/agent/grok/grok.go:84`). The reviewer, gate, architect, UI pass, spec check and spec draft are read-only (`internal/engine/perm.go:103-105`, `internal/engine/perm.go:124-131`).
- Each harness's plan mode adds its own instruction: Claude asks for ExitPlanMode, Grok for plan.md and exit_plan_mode (S412, S414, S427 evidence). Neither the role prompts nor the brief mention plan mode for Claude. For Grok the brief names only the commands that run in plan mode (`internal/engine/brief.go:251-255`).
- The brief already says the report is the final message: the Your files section (`internal/engine/brief.go:158-161`) and the done-when line (`internal/engine/brief.go:249-250`). It does not say to ignore the harness's plan-mode request.
- adj 372 (`roles.ui-pass-write-mechanism`, decided 2026-11-16) moved the cloud UI pass off plan mode to an allowlist with `--permission-prompts none`, because plan mode refused its writes. Whether the reviewer and gate keep plan mode is open: S412 and S414 asked not to run them under it.

Open owner question: whether read-only roles stay in plan mode and are told how to treat it (this spec), or leave plan mode. Per the owner's answer to `roles.read-only-plan-mode`.

## Implement

1. Write the failing tests and see each red for the stated reason.
2. `internal/daemon/runner.go`: for every read-only request on cloud `claude`, set the allowlist to the read-only list (`LocalReadOnlyAllowlist`, plus `Bash(adj find*)` for the spec check). The UI pass keeps `Skill` and its write directory.
3. `internal/agent/claude/args.go`: cloud read-only runs on `--allowedTools` and `--permission-prompts none`, with no permission mode flag, as the UI pass does (adj 372). A cloud read-only spec with an empty allowlist is an error. claude-local is unchanged.
4. Grok read-only roles keep plan mode; do not change `internal/agent/grok`.
5. The tree fingerprint around read-only roles stays (adj 28): a read-only role that changes the tree still fails.
6. Docs: `docs/design.md` Roles says cloud Claude read-only roles run on the read-only allowlist and Grok ones in plan mode, citing adj 489 and adj 372. Changelog entry with `slicer changelog add S418 --text "..."`.
